name: Oliver
title: AQA Environmental Science examiner for five years · teaches at a top sixth-form college
bio: Oliver has been an examiner for AQA Environmental Science for five years, so he has an excellent understanding of the demands and details of the specification. He has taught Environmental Science at a top sixth-form college for many years.

His online one-to-one lessons are built around what earns marks on the two three-hour papers: applying what you know to unfamiliar data, the research methods and statistics questions that appear on both papers, and planning the nine-mark and 25-mark extended answers so they reach the top level.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for Year 12 and Year 13, at a regular weekly slot
Topic-by-topic teaching of anything that hasn't clicked in class, from biogeochemical cycles to the circular economy
Research methods, sampling and statistical tests, including the calculation questions
Past-paper questions and essays marked the way an AQA examiner marks them, with feedback on where the marks went
Mock-paper walk-throughs before the May exams
